svg.title: Where each of the four metric families is sampled across one beat
svg.text: LoopScheduler instruments itself across the beat - it is the only thing that knows the loop's timing.
Each family is exposed three ways - raw, EMA-smoothed, and a recent windowed peak - beside a plain
ticks-per-second rate. CPU load is the duty cycle, so it counts the work, the loop overhead and the ~1 ms
busy-wait: everything except the real sleep.
